activities.title: The Long Way Home
activities.summary: Help Maya return a lost bag to a retired dock worker; reveals she once worked near the port.
activities.consequence: Maya gains trust; unlocks a personal conversation.

activities.title: Parts Run
activities.summary: Recover three rare engine parts from small repair yards.

activities.title: One Last Tune
activities.summary: Test Nico's rebuilt car on a short legal time-trial route.

activities.title: Information Has a Price
activities.summary: Find the source of a false rumour before Vesper sells it as fact.
activities.consequence: Vesper's later information is more reliable.

activities.title: Loose Ends
activities.summary: Deliver a sealed envelope and choose whether to inspect it or respect the deal.
activities.consequence: Changes Vesper's trust and one late-game support option.

activities.title: Last Delivery
activities.summary: Complete a multi-stop courier route before the timer expires.

activities.title: Coastline Sprint
activities.summary: Race a short loop along the coast without damaging the borrowed car.

activities.title: Scrap Value
activities.summary: Find salvageable electronic components around the warehouse edge.

activities.title: Quiet Water
activities.summary: Search the canal path for a missing dog and return it safely.

activities.title: Vice in Frames
activities.summary: Photograph five landmarks from marked viewpoints.
activities.consequence: Adds entries to the city journal.
